reviews.review: Really fun game. There is a remake though, I didn't realise that when I bought it, so the remake might be more worth your money, not sure.

A timeless classic. Artifacts make this game extra fun, do think things are a bit tanky otherwise. Gameplay loop is solid, and the item synergies let you go crazy, to the point of crashing your game by existing. 

I do have some issues with the game, like the movement across a sprawling stage. It definitely gets tedious, but picks up with a movement item or two. Big hater of having to hunt every mob to open the portal. I do mean *every* mob, looking at you stray wisp in a corner on the other side of the map. Also WHY DOES [final boss] HAVE A RANDOM MONSTER LOG DROP CHANCE AHHH I'M GOING INSANE OH GOD THE MISERY-

Anyways, outside of that, great game, great music, great pixel art, great gameplay loop.

[h1]
Random generated micro platformer with much appreciated action combat system. Don't forget to wear your magnifying glass! Explore alien planet, defeat enemies and activate portal to escape. Game is pretty damn hard to be honest and I guarantee you will not complete it on first go. Lots of stuff to gather like drones, weapons etc. Soundtrack is really awesome on this one and you gonna love it. Main con here is that you can nerf enemies from safe distance not taking titular "Risk". Make sure to play Risk of Rain Returns, new and improved version or just jump right into Risk of Rain 2 which is a 3D game with exploration and lots of combat which I recommend with my dwarf grandfather.
[/h1]
